description: This file defines the interface for a class `em_provisioning_t` responsible for handling various provisioning and messaging operations within a Wi-Fi mesh system. It includes virtual methods for managing device states, sending and processing different message types (e.g., DPP, 1905 messages), and encapsulates functions related to mesh provisioning protocols.

classes.name: em_provisioning_t
classes.description: An abstract class managing provisioning operations, message handling, and state management in a mesh network environment.
